```text
1	import { outboxService, ClaimedOutboxEvent, OUTBOX_STATUS } from '../services/outbox.service';
2	import { notificationService } from '../services/notification.service';
3	
4	/**
5	 * OutboxWorker
6	 * ------------
7	 * Background polling loop that drains the transactional outbox and delivers
8	 * each event to the Carrier Notify API.
9	 *
10	 * Guarantees:
11	 *  - Non-blocking: runs entirely outside the request path, so booking API
12	 *    responses never wait on a webhook HTTP call.
13	 *  - At-least-once: an event is only marked COMPLETED after a 2xx response;
14	 *    any other outcome returns it to PENDING with exponential backoff.
15	 *  - Duplicate-safe: events are atomically claimed (PROCESSING) so two workers
16	 *    never dispatch the same row, and every request carries the persisted
17	 *    eventId as X-Event-Id / Idempotency-Key so a redelivery after a
18	 *    "delivered but not recorded" crash is de-duplicated by the receiver.
19	 *  - Bounded: after maxRetries the event is parked as FAILED for review rather
20	 *    than retried forever.
21	 */
22	
23	export interface OutboxWorkerConfig {
24	  pollIntervalMs: number;
25	  batchSize: number;
26	  maxConcurrency: number;
27	  processingLeaseMs: number;
28	  maxBatchesPerTick: number;
29	  enabled: boolean;
30	}
31	
32	function readPositiveInt(name: string, fallback: number, allowZero = false): number {
33	  const raw = process.env[name];
34	  if (raw === undefined || raw === '') return fallback;
35	  const parsed = parseInt(raw, 10);
36	  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return fallback;
37	  if (parsed < 0 || (parsed === 0 && !allowZero)) return fallback;
38	  return parsed;
39	}
40	
41	export class OutboxWorker {
42	  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
43	  private currentTick: Promise<void> | null = null;
44	  private running = false;
45	  private started = false;
46	
47	  public readonly config: OutboxWorkerConfig = {
48	    pollIntervalMs: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS', 5000),
49	    batchSize: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE', 25),
50	    maxConcurrency: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_MAX_CONCURRENCY', 5),
51	    processingLeaseMs: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_PROCESSING_LEASE_MS', 60_000),
52	    maxBatchesPerTick: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_MAX_BATCHES_PER_TICK', 4),
53	    enabled: process.env.OUTBOX_WORKER_ENABLED !== 'false',
54	  };
55	
56	  /** True while a polling cycle is in flight. */
57	  public get isBusy(): boolean {
58	    return this.running;
59	  }
60	
61	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
62	  // Lifecycle
63	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
64	
65	  /**
66	   * Starts the polling loop and kicks off an immediate cycle so events created
67	   * during boot are not delayed by a full interval.
68	   */
69	  public start(): void {
70	    if (this.started) {
71	      console.warn('[OutboxWorker] start() ignored - worker is already running.');
72	      return;
73	    }
74	
75	    if (!this.config.enabled) {
76	      console.log('[OutboxWorker] Disabled via OUTBOX_WORKER_ENABLED=false. No events will be dispatched.');
77	      return;
78	    }
79	
80	    this.started = true;
81	
82	    console.log(
83	      `[OutboxWorker] Started | interval=${this.config.pollIntervalMs}ms ` +
84	        `batch=${this.config.batchSize} concurrency=${this.config.maxConcurrency} ` +
85	        `lease=${this.config.processingLeaseMs}ms target=${process.env.CARRIER_NOTIFY_URL || 'http://localhost:4001/notify'}`
86	    );
87	
88	    this.timer = setInterval(() => {
89	      void this.tick();
90	    }, this.config.pollIntervalMs);
91	
92	    // Do not hold the event loop open on the worker's account - the HTTP server
93	    // owns process lifetime, and this keeps test runners from hanging.
94	    this.timer.unref?.();
95	
96	    void this.tick();
97	  }
98	
99	  /**
100	   * Stops scheduling new cycles and waits for the in-flight one to finish, so
101	   * every claimed event reaches a terminal state before the process exits.
102	   */
103	  public async stop(): Promise<void> {
104	    if (!this.started) return;
105	
106	    this.started = false;
107	
108	    if (this.timer) {
109	      clearInterval(this.timer);
110	      this.timer = null;
111	    }
112	
113	    if (this.currentTick) {
114	      console.log('[OutboxWorker] Waiting for in-flight delivery cycle to finish...');
115	      await this.currentTick;
116	    }
117	
118	    console.log('[OutboxWorker] Stopped.');
119	  }
120	
121	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
122	  // Poll cycle
123	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
124	
125	  /** Single poll cycle. Guarded against re-entrancy so cycles never overlap. */
126	  public async tick(): Promise<void> {
127	    if (this.running) {
128	      // Previous cycle is still working through a slow batch; skip this beat.
129	      return;
130	    }
131	
132	    this.running = true;
133	    this.currentTick = this.runCycle();
134	
135	    try {
136	      await this.currentTick;
137	    } finally {
138	      this.running = false;
139	      this.currentTick = null;
140	    }
141	  }
142	
143	  private async runCycle(): Promise<void> {
144	    try {
145	      const recovered = await outboxService.recoverStaleProcessing(
146	        this.config.processingLeaseMs
147	      );
148	      if (recovered > 0) {
149	        console.warn(
150	          `[OutboxWorker] Requeued ${recovered} event(s) abandoned in PROCESSING by a previous worker.`
151	        );
152	      }
153	
154	      for (let batch = 0; batch < this.config.maxBatchesPerTick; batch++) {
155	        const claimed = await outboxService.claimPendingEvents(this.config.batchSize);
156	        if (claimed.length === 0) return;
157	
158	        console.log(`[OutboxWorker] Claimed ${claimed.length} event(s) for delivery.`);
159	        await this.dispatchBatch(claimed);
160	      }
161	    } catch (error: any) {
162	      // A polling cycle must never crash the process - the next tick retries.
163	      console.error(`[OutboxWorker] Poll cycle failed: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
164	    }
165	  }
166	
167	  /** Delivers a claimed batch with bounded parallelism. */
168	  private async dispatchBatch(events: ClaimedOutboxEvent[]): Promise<void> {
169	    await this.runWithConcurrency(events, this.config.maxConcurrency, (event) =>
170	      this.dispatchEvent(event)
171	    );
172	  }
173	
174	  /**
175	   * Delivers one event and commits its outcome. A failure to *record* the
176	   * outcome is logged but deliberately not rethrown: the event stays
177	   * PROCESSING and the stale-claim sweep will requeue it.
178	   */
179	  private async dispatchEvent(event: ClaimedOutboxEvent): Promise<void> {
180	    const result = await notificationService.dispatchCarrierNotification(
181	      event.eventId,
182	      event.payload
183	    );
184	
185	    try {
186	      if (result.ok) {
187	        await outboxService.markCompleted(event);
188	        console.log(
189	          `[OutboxWorker] Delivered event ${event.eventId} (outbox #${event.id}, ` +
190	            `${event.payload?.eventType}) -> HTTP ${result.status}`
191	        );
192	        return;
193	      }
194	
195	      const detail = result.error
196	        ? result.error
197	        : `HTTP ${result.status} from carrier notify API: ${this.describeBody(result.body)}`;
198	
199	      if (!notificationService.isRetryable(result)) {
200	        await outboxService.markFailed(event, `Non-retryable ${detail}`);
201	        console.error(
202	          `[OutboxWorker] Event ${event.eventId} parked as FAILED (non-retryable). ${detail}`
203	        );
204	        return;
205	      }
206	
207	      const outcome = await outboxService.recordFailure(event, detail);
208	
209	      if (outcome.status === OUTBOX_STATUS.FAILED) {
210	        console.error(
211	          `[OutboxWorker] Event ${event.eventId} FAILED permanently after ` +
212	            `${outcome.retryCount - 1}/${event.maxRetries} retries. ${detail}`
213	        );
214	      } else {
215	        console.warn(
216	          `[OutboxWorker] Event ${event.eventId} attempt ${outcome.retryCount}/${event.maxRetries} ` +
217	            `failed. Retrying in ${outcome.delayMs}ms at ${outcome.nextRetryAt?.toISOString()}. ${detail}`
218	        );
219	      }
220	    } catch (error: any) {
221	      console.error(
222	        `[OutboxWorker] Could not record outcome for event ${event.eventId}: ` +
223	          `${error?.message || String(error)}`
224	      );
225	    }
226	  }
227	
228	  private describeBody(body: any): string {
229	    if (body === null || body === undefined) return '(empty response body)';
230	    if (typeof body === 'string') return body.slice(0, 300);
231	    try {
232	      return JSON.stringify(body).slice(0, 300);
233	    } catch {
234	      return '(unserializable response body)';
235	    }
236	  }
237	
238	  /** Simple worker-pool: at most `limit` promises in flight at any moment. */
239	  private async runWithConcurrency<T>(
240	    items: T[],
241	    limit: number,
242	    task: (item: T) => Promise<void>
243	  ): Promise<void> {
244	    const queue = [...items];
245	    const lanes = Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, queue.length) }, async () => {
246	      for (let item = queue.shift(); item !== undefined; item = queue.shift()) {
247	        await task(item);
248	      }
249	    });
250	
251	    await Promise.all(lanes);
252	  }
253	}
254	
255	export const outboxWorker = new OutboxWorker();
```

```text
30	   * Helper to validate that a time slot falls within warehouse operating hours.
31	   */
32	  private validateSlotOperatingHours(warehouse: any, slotStart: Date, slotEnd: Date) {
33	    if (isNaN(slotStart.getTime()) || isNaN(slotEnd.getTime())) {
34	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid slotStartTime or slotEndTime format.' };
35	    }
36	
37	    if (slotEnd <= slotStart) {
38	      throw { status: 400, message: 'slotEndTime must be greater than slotStartTime.' };
39	    }
40	
41	    if (slotStart.getTime() < Date.now()) {
42	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Cannot book or reschedule a slot in the past.' };
43	    }
44	
45	    const warehouseTz = warehouse.timezone;
46	    const dateStr = formatInTimeZone(slotStart, warehouseTz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
47	    const startLocal = formatInTimeZone(slotStart, warehouseTz, 'HH:mm');
48	    const endLocal = formatInTimeZone(slotEnd, warehouseTz, 'HH:mm');
49	    const dayOfWeek = getDayOfWeekInTimeZone(dateStr, warehouseTz);
50	
51	    const opHour = warehouse.operatingHours.find(
52	      (oh: any) => oh.dayOfWeek === dayOfWeek || (dayOfWeek === 7 && oh.dayOfWeek === 0)
53	    );
54	
55	    if (!opHour) {
56	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Warehouse is closed on the requested date.' };
57	    }
58	
59	    const startMin = timeStringToMinutes(startLocal);
60	    let endMin = timeStringToMinutes(endLocal);
61	    if (endLocal === '00:00' && endMin === 0) {
62	      endMin = 1440;
63	    }
64	
65	    const openMin = timeStringToMinutes(opHour.openTime);
66	    let closeMin = timeStringToMinutes(opHour.closeTime);
67	    if ((opHour.closeTime === '24:00' || opHour.closeTime === '00:00') && openMin === 0) {
68	      closeMin = 1440;
69	    }
70	
71	    if (startMin < openMin || endMin > closeMin) {
72	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Requested slot falls outside warehouse operating hours.' };
73	    }
74	
75	    const durationMinutes = (slotEnd.getTime() - slotStart.getTime()) / (60 * 1000);
76	    if (durationMinutes !== opHour.slotLengthMinutes) {
77	      throw {
78	        status: 400,
79	        message: `Slot duration must match warehouse slot length of ${opHour.slotLengthMinutes} minutes.`,
80	      };
81	    }
82	  }

184	
185	    // Verify requested slot is not under scheduled dock maintenance closure
186	    const overlappingClosure = await prisma.dockClosure.findFirst({
187	      where: {
188	        dockId: data.dockId,
189	        startTime: { lt: slotEnd },
190	        endTime: { gt: slotStart },
191	      },
192	    });
193	    if (overlappingClosure) {
194	      throw {
195	        status: 400,
196	        message: 'The requested dock slot is unavailable due to scheduled dock maintenance.',
197	      };
198	    }
199	
200	    // c. Execute the booking inside a Prisma transaction guaranteeing atomicity
201	    try {
202	      const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
203	        // Pre-check active booking for concurrency
204	        const existing = await tx.booking.findFirst({
205	          where: {
206	            dockId: data.dockId,
207	            slotStartTime: slotStart,
208	            status: { in: [BookingStatus.BOOKED, BookingStatus.ARRIVED] },
209	          },
210	        });
211	
212	        if (existing) {
213	          throw { status: 409, message: 'Conflict. The requested dock slot is already booked.' };
214	        }
215	
216	        // Insert new Booking record
217	        const booking = await tx.booking.create({
218	          data: {
219	            dockId: data.dockId,
220	            carrierOrgId: dispatcherOrgId,
221	            slotStartTime: slotStart,
222	            slotEndTime: slotEnd,
223	            truckPlate: data.truckPlate.trim(),
224	            driverName: data.driverName.trim(),
225	            driverPhone: data.driverPhone.trim(),
226	            cargoNote: data.cargoNote ? data.cargoNote.trim() : null,
227	            status: BookingStatus.BOOKED,
228	            activeLock: 'ACTIVE',
229	          },
230	          include: {
231	            dock: {
232	              include: {
233	                warehouse: true,
234	              },
235	            },
236	            carrierOrg: true,
237	          },
238	        });
239	
240	        // If userId is provided, create initial AuditLog
241	        if (userId) {
242	          await auditLogService.recordLog({
243	            bookingId: booking.id,
244	            userId,
245	            action: 'CREATED',
246	            details: {
247	              dockId: booking.dockId,
248	              slotStartTime: booking.slotStartTime.toISOString(),
249	              slotEndTime: booking.slotEndTime.toISOString(),
250	              truckPlate: booking.truckPlate,
251	              driverName: booking.driverName,
252	            },
253	            tx,
254	          });
255	        }
256	
257	        // Simultaneously create an OutboxEvent record in the same transaction, so the
258	        // booking and its carrier notification either both commit or both roll back.
259	        const summary = outboxService.toBookingSummary(booking);
260	        await outboxService.enqueue(tx, {
261	          aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
262	          aggregateId: booking.id,
263	          eventType: OUTBOX_EVENT_TYPE.BOOKING_CREATED,
264	          carrierOrg: { id: booking.carrierOrg.id, name: booking.carrierOrg.name },
265	          booking: summary,
266	          message:
267	            `New booking #${booking.id} confirmed for truck ${summary.truckPlate} ` +
268	            `at ${summary.dockName} (${summary.warehouseName}) on ${outboxService.describeSlot(summary)}.`,
269	        });
270	
271	        return booking;
272	      });
273	
274	      return result;
275	    } catch (error: any) {
276	      // d. Catch Prisma unique constraint violation (P2002 on @@unique([dockId, slotStartTime, activeLock]))
277	      if (error.code === 'P2002' || error.status === 409) {
278	        throw {
279	          status: 409,
280	          message: 'Conflict. The requested dock slot is already booked.',
281	        };
282	      }
283	      throw error;
284	    }
285	  }

287	  /**
288	   * Reschedules an existing booking to a new time slot or dock.
289	   * Validates tenant ownership, checks new slot availability within operating hours,
290	   * releases the old slot, locks the new slot, and logs an audit record.
291	   */
292	  async rescheduleBooking(
293	    bookingId: number,
294	    carrierOrgId: number,
295	    userId: number,
296	    data: RescheduleBookingInput
297	  ) {
298	    if (!bookingId || isNaN(bookingId)) {
299	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid booking ID.' };
300	    }
301	
302	    if (!data.slotStartTime || !data.slotEndTime) {
303	      throw { status: 400, message: 'slotStartTime and slotEndTime are required.' };
304	    }
305	
306	    const booking = await prisma.booking.findUnique({
307	      where: { id: bookingId },
308	      include: {
309	        dock: {
310	          include: {
311	            warehouse: {
312	              include: {
313	                operatingHours: true,
314	                policy: true,
315	              },
316	            },
317	          },
318	        },
319	        carrierOrg: true,
320	      },
321	    });
322	
323	    if (!booking) {
324	      throw { status: 404, message: 'Booking not found.' };
325	    }
326	
327	    if (booking.carrierOrgId !== carrierOrgId) {
328	      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage this booking.' };
329	    }
330	
331	    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.CANCELLED) {
332	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Cannot reschedule a cancelled booking.' };
333	    }
334	
335	    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.ARRIVED) {
336	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Cannot reschedule a booking that has already arrived.' };
337	    }
338	
339	    const targetDockId = data.dockId !== undefined ? data.dockId : booking.dockId;
340	    let targetDock = booking.dock;
341	
342	    const now = new Date();
343	    if (targetDockId !== booking.dockId) {
344	      const foundDock = await prisma.dock.findUnique({
345	        where: { id: targetDockId },
346	        include: {
347	          warehouse: {
348	            include: {
349	              operatingHours: true,
350	              policy: true,
351	            },
352	          },
353	          closures: {
354	            where: {
355	              startTime: { lte: now },
356	              endTime: { gte: now },
357	            },
358	          },
359	        },
360	      });
361	
362	      if (!foundDock) {
363	        throw { status: 404, message: 'Target dock not found.' };
364	      }
365	
366	      const hasClosure = foundDock.closures && foundDock.closures.length > 0;
367	      const targetEffectiveStatus = hasClosure || foundDock.status === DockStatus.MAINTENANCE
368	        ? DockStatus.MAINTENANCE
369	        : foundDock.status;
370	
371	      if (targetEffectiveStatus !== DockStatus.ACTIVE) {
372	        throw { status: 400, message: 'Target dock is currently under maintenance and cannot be booked.' };
373	      }
374	
375	      targetDock = foundDock;
376	    } else {
377	      const activeClosure = await prisma.dockClosure.findFirst({
378	        where: {
379	          dockId: booking.dockId,
380	          startTime: { lte: now },
381	          endTime: { gte: now },
382	        },
383	      });
384	
385	      if (booking.dock.status !== DockStatus.ACTIVE || activeClosure) {
386	        throw { status: 400, message: 'Dock is currently under maintenance and cannot be booked.' };
387	      }
388	    }
389	
390	    const slotStart = new Date(data.slotStartTime);
391	    const slotEnd = new Date(data.slotEndTime);
392	    this.validateSlotOperatingHours(targetDock.warehouse, slotStart, slotEnd);
393	
394	    // Enforce configurable warehouse booking policy & lock window rules
395	    const policy = targetDock.warehouse.policy || booking.dock.warehouse.policy;
396	    if (policy) {
397	      // 1. Max Advance Horizon Check on target slot
398	      const maxAdvanceMs = policy.maxAdvanceDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
399	      if (slotStart.getTime() > Date.now() + maxAdvanceMs) {
400	        throw {
401	          status: 400,
402	          message: `Policy violation: Bookings cannot be rescheduled more than ${policy.maxAdvanceDays} days in advance.`,
403	        };
404	      }
405	
406	      // 2. 24-Hour Lock Window & Same-Day Rescheduling Exception
407	      const hoursUntilCurrentSlot = (booking.slotStartTime.getTime() - Date.now()) / (60 * 60 * 1000);
408	      if (hoursUntilCurrentSlot < policy.bookingLockWindowHours) {
409	        const warehouseTz = targetDock.warehouse.timezone;
410	        const currentSlotDate = formatInTimeZone(booking.slotStartTime, warehouseTz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
411	        const targetSlotDate = formatInTimeZone(slotStart, warehouseTz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
412	
413	        if (currentSlotDate !== targetSlotDate) {
414	          throw {
415	            status: 400,
416	            message: `Cannot reschedule to a different date within the ${policy.bookingLockWindowHours}-hour lock window. Only same-day emergency rescheduling is permitted.`,
417	          };
418	        }
419	      }
420	    }
421	
422	    // Verify target slot is not under scheduled dock maintenance closure
423	    const overlappingClosure = await prisma.dockClosure.findFirst({
424	      where: {
425	        dockId: targetDockId,
426	        startTime: { lt: slotEnd },
427	        endTime: { gt: slotStart },
428	      },
429	    });
430	    if (overlappingClosure) {
431	      throw {
432	        status: 400,
433	        message: 'The requested dock slot is unavailable due to scheduled dock maintenance.',
434	      };
435	    }
436	
437	    try {
438	      const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
439	        // Pre-check if target dock slot is already booked by another active booking
440	        const existing = await tx.booking.findFirst({
441	          where: {
442	            dockId: targetDockId,
443	            slotStartTime: slotStart,
444	            status: { in: [BookingStatus.BOOKED, BookingStatus.ARRIVED] },
445	            id: { not: bookingId },
446	          },
447	        });
448	
449	        if (existing) {
450	          throw { status: 409, message: 'Conflict. The requested dock slot is already booked.' };
451	        }
452	
453	        // Update the booking record to the new dock and time slot
454	        const updatedBooking = await tx.booking.update({
455	          where: { id: bookingId },
456	          data: {
457	            dockId: targetDockId,
458	            slotStartTime: slotStart,
459	            slotEndTime: slotEnd,
460	            activeLock: 'ACTIVE',
461	          },
462	          include: {
463	            dock: {
464	              include: {
465	                warehouse: true,
466	              },
467	            },
468	            carrierOrg: true,
469	          },
470	        });
471	
472	        // Insert AuditLog with action RESCHEDULED
473	        await auditLogService.recordLog({
474	          bookingId,
475	          userId,
476	          action: 'RESCHEDULED',
477	          details: {
478	            oldDockId: booking.dockId,
479	            oldSlotStartTime: booking.slotStartTime.toISOString(),
480	            oldSlotEndTime: booking.slotEndTime.toISOString(),
481	            newDockId: targetDockId,
482	            newSlotStartTime: slotStart.toISOString(),
483	            newSlotEndTime: slotEnd.toISOString(),
484	            reason: data.reason ? data.reason.trim() : null,
485	          },
486	          tx,
487	        });
488	
489	        // Create OutboxEvent record for async carrier notification. The summary is
490	        // built from the *updated* booking so the carrier sees the new dock/slot,
491	        // while `changes` retains the previous slot for the audit trail.
492	        const previousSummary = outboxService.toBookingSummary(booking);
493	        const summary = outboxService.toBookingSummary(updatedBooking);
494	        const reason = data.reason ? data.reason.trim() : null;
495	
496	        await outboxService.enqueue(tx, {
497	          aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
498	          aggregateId: booking.id,
499	          eventType: OUTBOX_EVENT_TYPE.BOOKING_RESCHEDULED,
500	          carrierOrg: { id: booking.carrierOrg.id, name: booking.carrierOrg.name },
501	          booking: summary,
502	          message:
503	            `Booking #${booking.id} rescheduled from ${previousSummary.dockName} ` +
504	            `(${outboxService.describeSlot(previousSummary)}) to ${summary.dockName} ` +
505	            `(${outboxService.describeSlot(summary)})` +
506	            `${reason ? `. Reason: ${reason}` : '.'}`,
507	          changes: {
508	            oldDockId: previousSummary.dockId,
509	            oldDockName: previousSummary.dockName,
510	            oldSlotStartTime: previousSummary.slotStartTime,
511	            oldSlotEndTime: previousSummary.slotEndTime,
512	            newDockId: summary.dockId,
513	            newDockName: summary.dockName,
514	            newSlotStartTime: summary.slotStartTime,
515	            newSlotEndTime: summary.slotEndTime,
516	            reason,
517	          },
518	        });
519	
520	        return updatedBooking;
521	      });
522	
523	      return result;
524	    } catch (error: any) {
525	      if (error.code === 'P2002' || error.status === 409) {
526	        throw {
527	          status: 409,
528	          message: 'Conflict. The requested dock slot is already booked.',
529	        };
530	      }
531	      throw error;
532	    }
533	  }

535	  /**
536	   * Cancels a booking, releasing the time slot and recording an audit log.
537	   */
538	  async cancelBooking(
539	    bookingId: number,
540	    carrierOrgId: number,
541	    userId: number,
542	    reason?: string
543	  ) {
544	    if (!bookingId || isNaN(bookingId)) {
545	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid booking ID.' };
546	    }
547	
548	    const booking = await prisma.booking.findUnique({
549	      where: { id: bookingId },
550	      include: {
551	        dock: {
552	          include: {
553	            warehouse: {
554	              include: {
555	                policy: true,
556	              },
557	            },
558	          },
559	        },
560	        carrierOrg: true,
561	      },
562	    });
563	
564	    if (!booking) {
565	      throw { status: 404, message: 'Booking not found.' };
566	    }
567	
568	    if (booking.carrierOrgId !== carrierOrgId) {
569	      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage this booking.' };
570	    }
571	
572	    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.CANCELLED) {
573	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Booking is already cancelled.' };
574	    }
575	
576	    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.ARRIVED) {
577	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Cannot cancel a booking that has already arrived.' };
578	    }
579	
580	    // Enforce lock window restriction on cancellations
581	    const policy = booking.dock.warehouse.policy;
582	    if (policy) {
583	      const hoursUntilSlot = (booking.slotStartTime.getTime() - Date.now()) / (60 * 60 * 1000);
584	      if (hoursUntilSlot < policy.bookingLockWindowHours) {
585	        throw {
586	          status: 400,
587	          message: `Cannot cancel booking within the ${policy.bookingLockWindowHours}-hour lock window prior to scheduled slot.`,
588	        };
589	      }
590	    }
591	
592	    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
593	      // Update booking to CANCELLED and clear activeLock to release slot in unique index
594	      const updatedBooking = await tx.booking.update({
595	        where: { id: bookingId },
596	        data: {
597	          status: BookingStatus.CANCELLED,
598	          activeLock: null,
599	        },
600	        include: {
601	          dock: {
602	            include: {
603	              warehouse: true,
604	            },
605	          },
606	          carrierOrg: true,
607	        },
608	      });
609	
610	      // Record AuditLog
611	      await auditLogService.recordLog({
612	        bookingId,
613	        userId,
614	        action: 'CANCELLED',
615	        details: {
616	          reason: reason ? reason.trim() : 'Cancelled by carrier dispatcher',
617	          dockId: booking.dockId,
618	          slotStartTime: booking.slotStartTime.toISOString(),
619	          cancelledAt: new Date().toISOString(),
620	        },
621	        tx,
622	      });
623	
624	      // Simultaneously create OutboxEvent for the cancellation notification
625	      const summary = outboxService.toBookingSummary(updatedBooking);
626	      const cancellationReason = reason ? reason.trim() : null;
627	
628	      await outboxService.enqueue(tx, {
629	        aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
630	        aggregateId: booking.id,
631	        eventType: OUTBOX_EVENT_TYPE.BOOKING_CANCELLED,
632	        carrierOrg: { id: booking.carrierOrg.id, name: booking.carrierOrg.name },
633	        booking: summary,
634	        message:
635	          `Booking #${booking.id} for truck ${summary.truckPlate} at ${summary.dockName} ` +
636	          `(${outboxService.describeSlot(summary)}) has been cancelled` +
637	          `${cancellationReason ? `. Reason: ${cancellationReason}` : '.'}`,
638	        changes: {
639	          dockId: summary.dockId,
640	          dockName: summary.dockName,
641	          slotStartTime: summary.slotStartTime,
642	          slotEndTime: summary.slotEndTime,
643	          previousStatus: booking.status,
644	          reason: cancellationReason,
645	          cancelledAt: new Date().toISOString(),
646	        },
647	      });
648	
649	      return updatedBooking;
650	    });
651	
652	    return result;
653	  }

655	  /**
656	   * Retrieves audit logs for a booking enforcing strict dual-sided tenant visibility:
657	   * Accessible by the Carrier Organization that created the booking OR
658	   * the Warehouse Operator Organization that owns the dock/warehouse.
659	   */
660	  async getBookingAuditLogs(bookingId: number, organizationId: number) {
661	    if (!bookingId || isNaN(bookingId)) {
662	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid booking ID.' };
663	    }
664	
665	    if (!organizationId) {
666	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Organization context required.' };
667	    }
668	
669	    const booking = await prisma.booking.findUnique({
670	      where: { id: bookingId },
671	      include: {
672	        dock: {
673	          include: {
674	            warehouse: true,
675	          },
676	        },
677	        carrierOrg: true,
678	      },
679	    });
680	
681	    if (!booking) {
682	      throw { status: 404, message: 'Booking not found.' };
683	    }
684	
685	    const isCarrierTenant = booking.carrierOrgId === organizationId;
686	    const isWarehouseTenant = booking.dock.warehouse.organizationId === organizationId;
687	
688	    if (!isCarrierTenant && !isWarehouseTenant) {
689	      throw {
690	        status: 403,
691	        message: 'Forbidden. You do not have access to audit logs for this booking.',
692	      };
693	    }
694	
695	    const logs = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
696	      where: { bookingId },
697	      include: {
698	        user: {
699	          select: {
700	            id: true,
701	            email: true,
702	            role: true,
703	            organizationId: true,
704	            organization: {
705	              select: {
706	                id: true,
707	                name: true,
708	                type: true,
709	              },
710	            },
711	          },
712	        },
713	      },
714	      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
715	    });
716	
717	    return logs.map((log) => auditLogService.formatLogEntry(log));
718	  }

720	  /**
721	   * Retrieves bookings for the user's organization.
722	   */
723	  async getBookings(organizationId: number, role: string) {
724	    if (!organizationId) {
725	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Organization ID is required.' };
726	    }
727	
728	    if (role === 'CARRIER_ADMIN' || role === 'DISPATCHER') {
729	      return prisma.booking.findMany({
730	        where: { carrierOrgId: organizationId },
731	        include: {
732	          dock: {
733	            include: {
734	              warehouse: true,
735	            },
736	          },
737	        },
738	        orderBy: { slotStartTime: 'desc' },
739	      });
740	    }
741	
742	    // Warehouse Operator
743	    return prisma.booking.findMany({
744	      where: {
745	        dock: {
746	          warehouse: {
747	            organizationId,
748	          },
749	        },
750	      },
751	      include: {
752	        dock: {
753	          include: {
754	            warehouse: true,
755	          },
756	        },
757	        carrierOrg: true,
758	      },
759	      orderBy: { slotStartTime: 'desc' },
760	    });
761	  }

763	  /**
764	   * Updates booking status (ARRIVED, NO_SHOW, COMPLETED).
765	   * Verifies that the warehouse belongs to the requesting warehouse operator organization.
766	   * Records an audit log entry tracking the status change.
767	   */
768	  async updateBookingStatus(
769	    bookingId: number,
770	    warehouseAdminOrgId: number,
771	    userId: number,
772	    status: 'ARRIVED' | 'NO_SHOW' | 'COMPLETED'
773	  ) {
774	    if (!bookingId || isNaN(bookingId)) {
775	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid booking ID.' };
776	    }
777	
778	    const validStatuses = ['ARRIVED', 'NO_SHOW', 'COMPLETED'];
779	    if (!status || !validStatuses.includes(status)) {
780	      throw {
781	        status: 400,
782	        message: `Invalid status '${status}'. Allowed statuses are: ${validStatuses.join(', ')}.`,
783	      };
784	    }
785	
786	    const booking = await prisma.booking.findUnique({
787	      where: { id: bookingId },
788	      include: {
789	        dock: {
790	          include: {
791	            warehouse: true,
792	          },
793	        },
794	        carrierOrg: true,
795	      },
796	    });
797	
798	    if (!booking) {
799	      throw { status: 404, message: 'Booking not found.' };
800	    }
801	
802	    if (booking.dock.warehouse.organizationId !== warehouseAdminOrgId) {
803	      throw {
804	        status: 403,
805	        message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage bookings for this warehouse.',
806	      };
807	    }
808	
809	    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.CANCELLED) {
810	      throw {
811	        status: 400,
812	        message: 'Cannot update status of a cancelled booking.',
813	      };
814	    }
815	
816	    // Validation: Booking status can only be changed after the scheduled slot start time has [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]ed
817	    const now = new Date();
818	    if (now < new Date(booking.slotStartTime)) {
819	      throw {
820	        status: 400,
821	        message: 'Booking status can only be changed after the scheduled slot start time has [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]ed.',
822	      };
823	    }
824	
825	    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
826	      const updatedBooking = await tx.booking.update({
827	        where: { id: bookingId },
828	        data: {
829	          status: status as BookingStatus,
830	        },
831	        include: {
832	          dock: {
833	            include: {
834	              warehouse: true,
835	            },
836	          },
837	          carrierOrg: true,
838	        },
839	      });
840	
841	      // Record AuditLog entry tracking the status change
842	      await auditLogService.recordLog({
843	        bookingId,
844	        userId,
845	        action: 'STATUS_CHANGED',
846	        details: {
847	          oldStatus: booking.status,
848	          newStatus: status,
849	          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
850	        },
851	        tx,
852	      });
853	
854	      // Simultaneously create OutboxEvent for the status-change notification
855	      const summary = outboxService.toBookingSummary(updatedBooking);
856	
857	      await outboxService.enqueue(tx, {
858	        aggregateType: 'BOOKING',
859	        aggregateId: booking.id,
860	        eventType: OUTBOX_EVENT_TYPE.BOOKING_STATUS_CHANGED,
861	        carrierOrg: { id: booking.carrierOrg.id, name: booking.carrierOrg.name },
862	        booking: summary,
863	        message:
864	          `Booking #${booking.id} for truck ${summary.truckPlate} at ${summary.dockName} ` +
865	          `changed status from ${booking.status} to ${status}.`,
866	        changes: {
867	          oldStatus: booking.status,
868	          newStatus: status,
869	          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
870	        },
871	      });
872

879	  /**

881	   * Records an UPDATED audit log entry with change summary and actor metadata.
882	   */
883	  async updateBooking(
884	    bookingId: number,
885	    carrierOrgId: number,
886	    userId: number,
887	    data: {
888	      truckPlate?: string;
889	      driverName?: string;
890	      driverPhone?: string;
891	      cargoNote?: string;
892	    }
893	  ) {
894	    if (!bookingId || isNaN(bookingId)) {
895	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid booking ID.' };
896	    }
897	
898	    const booking = await prisma.booking.findUnique({
899	      where: { id: bookingId },
900	      include: {
901	        dock: {
902	          include: {
903	            warehouse: true,
904	          },
905	        },
906	        carrierOrg: true,
907	      },
908	    });
909	
910	    if (!booking) {
911	      throw { status: 404, message: 'Booking not found.' };
912	    }
913	
914	    if (booking.carrierOrgId !== carrierOrgId) {
915	      throw { status: 403, message: 'Forbidden. You do not have permission to manage this booking.' };
916	    }
917	
918	    if (booking.status === BookingStatus.CANCELLED) {
919	      throw { status: 400, message: 'Cannot update a cancelled booking.' };
920	    }
921

923	    if (data.truckPlate !== undefined && data.truckPlate.trim() !== booking.truckPlate) {
924	      changes.truckPlate = { old: booking.truckPlate, new: data.truckPlate.trim() };
925	    }
926	    if (data.driverName !== undefined && data.driverName.trim() !== booking.driverName) {
927	      changes.driverName = { old: booking.driverName, new: data.driverName.trim() };
928	    }
929	    if (data.driverPhone !== undefined && data.driverPhone.trim() !== booking.driverPhone) {
930	      changes.driverPhone = { old: booking.driverPhone, new: data.driverPhone.trim() };
931	    }
932	    if (data.cargoNote !== undefined && data.cargoNote.trim() !== (booking.cargoNote || '')) {
933	      changes.cargoNote = { old: booking.cargoNote, new: data.cargoNote.trim() };
934	    }
935	
936	    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
937	      const updatedBooking = await tx.booking.update({
938	        where: { id: bookingId },
939	        data: {
940	          ...(data.truckPlate !== undefined ? { truckPlate: data.truckPlate.trim() } : {}),
941	          ...(data.driverName !== undefined ? { driverName: data.driverName.trim() } : {}),
942	          ...(data.driverPhone !== undefined ? { driverPhone: data.driverPhone.trim() } : {}),

944	        },

948	              warehouse: true,
949	            },
950	          },
951	          carrierOrg: true,
952	        },
953	      });
954	
955	      const changeKeys = Object.keys(changes);
956	      const summary =
957	        changeKeys.length > 0
958	          ? `Booking updated: modified ${changeKeys.join(', ')}`
959	          : 'Booking details updated';
960	
961	      await auditLogService.recordLog({

965	        details: {

967	        },
968	        summary,
969	        tx,
970	      });
971	
972	      return updatedBooking;
```

```text
194	    const eventId = randomUUID();

206	        nextRetryAt: new Date(),

212	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
213	  // Consumer side - atomic claiming
214	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
215	
216	  /**
217	   * Atomically claims up to `batchSize` due events and flips them to PROCESSING
218	   * in a single transaction.
219	   *
220	   * The `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` row locks combined with the guarded
221	   * `status = 'PENDING'` predicate make claiming safe across concurrent worker
222	   * processes: a second worker blocks on the locked rows, and once the first
223	   * worker commits it re-evaluates the predicate, finds status = 'PROCESSING',
224	   * and claims nothing. No event can be claimed twice.
225	   */
226	  public async claimPendingEvents(batchSize: number): Promise<ClaimedOutboxEvent[]> {
227	    const size = Math.max(1, Math.floor(batchSize));
228	    const now = new Date();
229	
230	    const claimed = await prisma.$transaction(
231	      async (tx) => {
232	        // LIMIT cannot be bound as a prepared-statement parameter; `size` is
233	        // coerced to a validated integer above so this is injection-safe.
234	        const due = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ id: number }>>(Prisma.sql`
235	          SELECT id
236	            FROM outbox_events
237	           WHERE status = ${OUTBOX_STATUS.PENDING}
238	             AND nextRetryAt <= ${now}
239	           ORDER BY nextRetryAt ASC, id ASC
240	           LIMIT ${Prisma.raw(String(size))}
241	           FOR UPDATE
242	        `);
243	
244	        if (due.length === 0) return [];
245	
246	        const ids = due.map((row) => row.id);
247	
248	        await tx.outboxEvent.updateMany({
249	          where: { id: { in: ids }, status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PENDING },
250	          data: { status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PROCESSING },
251	        });
252	
253	        const rows = await tx.outboxEvent.findMany({
254	          where: { id: { in: ids }, status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PROCESSING },
255	          select: {
256	            id: true,
257	            eventId: true,
258	            aggregateType: true,
259	            aggregateId: true,
260	            payload: true,
261	            retryCount: true,
262	            maxRetries: true,
263	          },
264	          orderBy: { id: 'asc' },
265	        });
266	
267	        // The column is opaque JSON; the shape is guaranteed by `enqueue`.
268	        return rows.map((row) => ({
269	          ...row,
270	          payload: row.payload as unknown as OutboxPayload,
271	        }));
272	      },
273	      { timeout: 15000, maxWait: 10000 }
274	    );
275	
276	    return claimed;
277	  }
278	
279	  /**
280	   * Requeues events abandoned in PROCESSING by a worker that died mid-flight.
281	   * A PROCESSING row whose `updatedAt` is older than the lease has no live
282	   * owner, so it is returned to PENDING. The retry counter is incremented so a
283	   * permanently crashing event still terminates in FAILED rather than looping.
284	   */
285	  public async recoverStaleProcessing(leaseMs: number): Promise<number> {
286	    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - leaseMs);
287	
288	    const result = await prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
289	      where: {
290	        status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PROCESSING,
291	        updatedAt: { lt: cutoff },
292	      },
293	      data: {
294	        status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PENDING,
295	        nextRetryAt: new Date(),
296	        retryCount: { increment: 1 },
297	        lastError: 'Requeued after worker lease expired without a delivery outcome.',
298	      },
299	    });
300	
301	    return result.count;
302	  }
303	
304	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
305	  // Consumer side - outcome
306	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
307	
308	  /** Marks a claimed event as successfully delivered. */
309	  public async markCompleted(event: ClaimedOutboxEvent): Promise<void> {
310	    await prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
311	      where: { id: event.id, status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PROCESSING },
312	      data: {
313	        status: OUTBOX_STATUS.COMPLETED,
314	        lastError: null,
315	        nextRetryAt: new Date(),
316	      },
317	    });
318	  }
319	
320	  /**
321	   * Records a failed delivery attempt, applying exponential backoff.
322	   *
323	   * Delay = min(BACKOFF_BASE_MS * 2^retryCount, MAX_BACKOFF_MS) plus up to 20%
324	   * jitter so that a batch of events failing together does not retry in
325	   * lockstep. Once retryCount exceeds maxRetries the event is parked as FAILED
326	   * for administrative review instead of being rescheduled.
327	   *
328	   * Returns the decision taken so the caller can log it.
329	   */
330	  public async recordFailure(
331	    event: ClaimedOutboxEvent,
332	    errorDetail: string
333	  ): Promise<{ status: OutboxStatus; retryCount: number; nextRetryAt?: Date; delayMs?: number }> {
334	    const nextRetryCount = event.retryCount + 1;
335	
336	    if (nextRetryCount > event.maxRetries) {
337	      await prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
338	        where: { id: event.id, status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PROCESSING },
339	        data: {
340	          status: OUTBOX_STATUS.FAILED,
341	          retryCount: nextRetryCount,
342	          lastError: `Exhausted ${event.maxRetries} retries. Last error: ${errorDetail}`.slice(0, 4000),
343	        },
344	      });
345	
346	      return { status: OUTBOX_STATUS.FAILED, retryCount: nextRetryCount };
347	    }
348	
349	    const exponential = this.backoffBaseMs * Math.pow(2, nextRetryCount);
350	    const capped = Math.min(exponential, this.maxBackoffMs);
351	    const jitter = Math.floor(capped * 0.2 * Math.random());
352	    const delayMs = capped + jitter;
353	    const nextRetryAt = new Date(Date.now() + delayMs);
354	
355	    await prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
356	      where: { id: event.id, status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PROCESSING },
357	      data: {
358	        status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PENDING,
359	        retryCount: nextRetryCount,
360	        nextRetryAt,
361	        lastError: errorDetail.slice(0, 4000),
362	      },
363	    });
364	
365	    return {
366	      status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PENDING,
367	      retryCount: nextRetryCount,
368	      nextRetryAt,
369	      delayMs,
370	    };
371	  }
372	
373	  /**
374	   * Parks an event as FAILED without consuming retries. Used when a failure is
375	   * provably permanent (non-retryable 4xx from the receiver).
376	   */
377	  public async markFailed(event: ClaimedOutboxEvent, errorDetail: string): Promise<void> {
378	    await prisma.outboxEvent.updateMany({
379	      where: { id: event.id, status: OUTBOX_STATUS.PROCESSING },
380	      data: {
381	        status: OUTBOX_STATUS.FAILED,
382	        lastError: errorDetail.slice(0, 4000),
383	      },
384	    });
385	  }
386	
387	  /** Event counts per status, for operational inspection. */
388	  public async getStats(): Promise<OutboxStats> {
389	    const grouped = await prisma.outboxEvent.groupBy({
390	      by: ['status'],
391	      _count: { _all: true },
392	    });
393	
394	    const stats: OutboxStats = {
395	      PENDING: 0,
396	      PROCESSING: 0,
397	      COMPLETED: 0,
398	      FAILED: 0,
399	    };
400	
401	    for (const row of grouped) {
402	      if (row.status in stats) {
403	        stats[row.status as keyof OutboxStats] = row._count._all;
404	      }
405	    }
406	
407	    return stats;
408	  }
409	}
```

```text
1	import type { Server } from 'http';
2	import app from './app';
3	import { prisma } from './config/db.config';
4	import { outboxWorker } from './workers/outbox.worker';
5	
6	const PORT = process.env.PORT || 5000;
7	
8	/** How long to wait for in-flight work before forcing the process to exit. */
9	const SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
10	
11	if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
12	  const server: Server = app.listen(PORT, () => {
13	    console.log(`Server is running on port ${PORT}`);
14	    console.log(`Swagger documentation available at http://localhost:${PORT}/api-docs`);
15	  });
16	
17	  // Start the transactional outbox drain loop. It runs entirely outside the
18	  // request path, so booking endpoints return as soon as the DB transaction commits.
19	  outboxWorker.start();
20	
21	  let shuttingDown = false;
22	
23	  const shutdown = async (signal: string) => {
24	    if (shuttingDown) return;
25	    shuttingDown = true;
26	
27	    console.log(`[Server] ${signal} received. Shutting down gracefully...`);
28	
29	    // Hard deadline: never hang the process on a stuck socket or delivery cycle.
30	    const forceExit = setTimeout(() => {
31	      console.error('[Server] Graceful shutdown timed out. Forcing exit.');
32	      process.exit(1);
33	    }, SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS);
34	    forceExit.unref();
35	
36	    try {
37	      // 1. Stop dispatching and let any in-flight webhook cycle settle so no
38	      //    event is left stranded in PROCESSING.
39	      await outboxWorker.stop();
40	
41	      // 2. Stop accepting new connections and finish in-flight HTTP responses.
42	      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.close(() => resolve()));
43	
44	      // 3. Release database connections.
45	      await prisma.$disconnect();
46	
47	      clearTimeout(forceExit);
48	      console.log('[Server] Shutdown complete.');
49	      process.exit(0);
50	    } catch (error: any) {
51	      console.error(`[Server] Error during shutdown: ${error?.message || String(error)}`);
52	      process.exit(1);
53	    }
54	  };
55	
56	  process.on('SIGINT', () => void shutdown('SIGINT'));
57	  process.on('SIGTERM', () => void shutdown('SIGTERM'));
58	}
59	
60	export { app };
61	export default app;
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * NotificationService
3	 * -------------------
4	 * Transport layer for outbound carrier webhook notifications.
5	 *
6	 * This service performs exactly one job: POST a single outbox payload to the
7	 * external Carrier Notify API and report the outcome. It never writes to the
8	 * database and never retries - scheduling and retry policy belong to the
9	 * OutboxWorker / OutboxService.
10	 *
11	 * Every request carries the outbox event id as both `X-Event-Id` and
12	 * `Idempotency-Key` so the receiver can de-duplicate redeliveries.
13	 */
14	
15	export interface CarrierNotifyResult {
16	  /** True only for a 2xx response. */
17	  ok: boolean;
18	  /** HTTP status code, or 0 when the request never produced a response. */
19	  status: number;
20	  /** Parsed JSON response body when available. */
21	  body: any;
22	  /** Transport-level failure detail (network error / timeout). */
23	  error?: string;
24	  /** True when the failure was a client-side timeout or connection reset. */
25	  timedOut: boolean;
26	}
27	
28	export class NotificationService {
29	  private get webhookUrl(): string {
30	    return process.env.CARRIER_NOTIFY_URL || 'http://localhost:4001/notify';
31	  }
32	
33	  private get timeoutMs(): number {
34	    const parsed = parseInt(process.env.OUTBOX_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS || '8000', 10);
35	    return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 8000;
36	  }
37	
38	  private get authToken(): string | undefined {
39	    const token = process.env.CARRIER_NOTIFY_TOKEN;
40	    return token && token.trim() ? token.trim() : undefined;
41	  }
42	
43	  /**
44	   * True when the failure is worth retrying with backoff. Network errors and
45	   * timeouts always are; among HTTP responses, 408/425/429 and all 5xx are
46	   * transient, while other 4xx responses indicate a malformed request that
47	   * would fail identically on every redelivery.
48	   */
49	  public isRetryable(result: CarrierNotifyResult): boolean {
50	    if (result.timedOut || result.error) return true;
51	    if (result.status === 0) return true;
52	    if (result.status >= 200 && result.status < 300) return false;
53	    if ([408, 425, 429].includes(result.status)) return true;
54	    if (result.status >= 500) return true;
55	    return false;
56	  }
57	
58	  /**
59	   * Dispatches one outbox event to the carrier webhook. Never throws: all
60	   * failures are returned as a structured result so the caller decides policy.
61	   */
62	  public async dispatchCarrierNotification(
63	    eventId: string,
64	    payload: unknown
65	  ): Promise<CarrierNotifyResult> {
66	    const url = this.webhookUrl;
67	    const timeoutMs = this.timeoutMs;
68	    const controller = new AbortController();
69	    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
70	
71	    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
72	      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
73	      'X-Event-Id': eventId,
74	      'Idempotency-Key': eventId,
75	      'User-Agent': 'DockSlot-OutboxWorker/1.0',
76	    };
77	
78	    const token = this.authToken;
79	    if (token) {
80	      headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
81	    }
82	
83	    try {
84	      const response = await fetch(url, {
85	        method: 'POST',
86	        headers,
87	        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
88	        signal: controller.signal,
89	      });
90	
91	      const raw = await response.text();
92	      return {
93	        ok: response.ok,
94	        status: response.status,
95	        body: this.parseJson(raw),
96	        timedOut: false,
97	      };
98	    } catch (error: any) {
99	      const timedOut = error?.name === 'AbortError' || error?.code === 'ABORT_ERR';
100	      const message = timedOut
101	        ? `Request to ${url} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`
102	        : `Network error calling ${url}: ${error?.message || String(error)}`;
103	
104	      return { ok: false, status: 0, body: null, error: message, timedOut };
105	    } finally {
106	      clearTimeout(timer);
107	    }
108	  }
109	
110	  private parseJson(raw: string): any {
111	    if (!raw) return null;
112	    try {
113	      return JSON.parse(raw);
114	    } catch {
115	      // Receiver returned non-JSON (HTML error page, plain text, empty body).
116	      return { raw: raw.slice(0, 500) };
117	    }
118	  }
119	}
120	
121	export const notificationService = new NotificationService();
122
```

First `utils/requestContext.ts`.

```ts
import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'async_hooks';

export interface RequestContext {
  requestId: string;
}

const storage = new AsyncLocalStorage<RequestContext>();

/** Runs `fn` with `context` bound as the ambient request context... */
export function runWithRequestContext<T>(context: RequestContext, fn: () => T): T {
  return storage.run(context, fn);
}

/** The requestId of the in-flight HTTP request, or undefined outside one. */
export function getRequestId(): string | undefined {
  return storage.getStore()?.requestId;
}

export function getRequestContext(): RequestContext | undefined {
  return storage.getStore();
}
```

Note: AsyncLocalStorage propagates through promises and async/await. `storage.run(ctx, fn)` where fn returns a promise — the context is active for the whole async chain created within. But Express middleware calling `next()` synchronously inside `storage.run(...)` keeps the context for downstream handlers because they're invoked synchronously within the run callback. Yes — standard pattern:

```ts
als.run({requestId}, () => next());
```

This works because Express calls downstream middleware synchronously within next(). Good.

```typescript
import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'async_hooks';

/**
 * RequestContext
 * --------------
 * Ambient per-request storage used to carry the correlation id from the HTTP
 * edge (requestLogger middleware) down into services and, from there, into the
 * persisted outbox payload.
 *
 * A booking is created several call frames below the middleware and the service
 * layer has no access to the Express `req`, so the id cannot be threaded through
 * as an argument without polluting every signature. AsyncLocalStorage keeps the
 * id attached to the async execution chain instead, which also means it survives
 * `await` and Prisma transaction callbacks.
 */

export interface RequestContext {
  /** Correlation id: the inbound `X-Request-ID` or a freshly generated UUID. */
  requestId: string;
}

const storage = new AsyncLocalStorage<RequestContext>();

/**
 * Runs `fn` with `context` bound as the ambient request context. Everything
 * `fn` does - including promises it awaits and callbacks it registers - inherits
 * the binding.
 */
export function runWithRequestContext<T>(context: RequestContext, fn: () => T): T {
  return storage.run(context, fn);
}

/** The correlation id of the request being served, or `undefined` outside one. */
export function getRequestId(): string | undefined {
  return storage.getStore()?.requestId;
}

/** The full ambient context, or `undefined` outside a request. */
export function getRequestContext(): RequestContext | undefined {
  return storage.getStore();
}

```

```typescript
import pino, { Logger, LoggerOptions } from 'pino';

/**
 * Structured application logger (Pino).
 *
 * Every log line is a JSON document with the fields needed to trace a request
 * end-to-end: `requestId`, `eventId` and `bookingId` are attached by the callers
 * that know them (the HTTP middleware and the outbox worker) via `childLogger`.
 *
 * In development the stream is piped through `pino-pretty` for readability. In
 * production (and in tests) raw NDJSON is emitted, because that is what log
 * aggregators ingest - and because the pretty transport spawns a worker thread
 * that would keep the test runner alive.
 */

const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';
const isTest = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test';

/** Extra bindings present on every line, so log sources are distinguishable. */
const base: LoggerOptions['base'] = {
  service: '[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]-backend',
  env: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
};

/**
 * Values that must never reach the log stream verbatim. Credentials arrive on
 * request headers and in webhook dispatch options, both of which are logged.
 */
const redact: LoggerOptions['redact'] = {
  paths: [
    'req.headers.authorization',
    'req.headers.cookie',
    'req.headers["x-api-key"]',
    'headers.authorization',
    'headers.Authorization',
    'headers["idempotency-key"]',
    '*.[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]',
    '*.[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]Hash',
    '*.token',
    '*.refreshToken',
    '*.totpSecret',
  ],
  censor: '[REDACTED]',
};

/**
 * `pino-pretty` is a devDependency, so it is absent from a production install.
 * Resolving it defensively means a misconfigured `NODE_ENV` degrades to plain
 * JSON instead of crashing the process at boot.
 */
function resolveTransport(): LoggerOptions['transport'] {
  if (isProduction || isTest) return undefined;
  if (process.env.LOG_PRETTY === 'false') return undefined;

  try {
    require.resolve('pino-pretty');
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }

  return {
    target: 'pino-pretty',
    options: {
      colorize: true,
      translateTime: 'SYS:HH:MM:ss.l',
      ignore: 'pid,hostname,service,env',
      messageFormat: '{if requestId}[{requestId}] {end}{msg}',
    },
  };
}

export const logger: Logger = pino({
  level:
    process.env.LOG_LEVEL ||
    // Silent by default under vitest so assertion output stays readable.
    (isTest ? 'silent' : 'info'),
  base,
  redact,
  timestamp: pino.stdTimeFunctions.isoTime,
  transport: resolveTransport(),
});

/**
 * Creates a child logger with additional context bound to every line it emits.
 *
 * Keys whose value is `undefined` are dropped rather than serialised, so logs
 * for requests without a correlation id (or events written before tracing
 * existed) stay clean instead of carrying null fields.
 */
export function childLogger(bindings: Record<string, unknown>): Logger {
  const defined = Object.entries(bindings).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined);

  if (defined.length === 0) return logger;

  return logger.child(Object.fromEntries(defined));
}

export default logger;
```

```ts
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

import { runWithRequestContext } from '../utils/requestContext';

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      requestId: string;
    }
  }
}

export const REQUEST_ID_HEADER = 'X-Request-ID';
const MAX_REQUEST_ID_LENGTH = 128;
const SAFE_REQUEST_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9._:+-]+$/;
```

```ts
export function resolveRequestId(req: Request): string {
  const raw = req.headers[REQUEST_ID_HEADER.toLowerCase()];
  const candidate = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw;
  if (
    typeof candidate === 'string' &&
    candidate.length > 0 &&
    candidate.length <= MAX_REQUEST_ID_LENGTH &&
    SAFE_REQUEST_ID.test(candidate)
  ) {
    return candidate;
  }
  return uuidv4();
}
```

Sanitization rationale: prevents log injection (newlines/control chars) and response header splitting from an attacker-controlled header.

Then middleware:

```ts
export const requestLogger = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  const requestId = resolveRequestId(req);
  req.requestId = requestId;

  // Echo the id so a client (or an upstream gateway) can quote it in a bug report.
  res.setHeader(REQUEST_ID_HEADER, requestId);

  const log = childLogger({ requestId });
  const startedAt = process.hrtime.bigint();

  log.info({
    method: req.method,
    url: req.originalUrl,
    ip: req.ip,
    userAgent: req.get('user-agent'),
  }, 'HTTP request received');

  let settled = false;
  const logOutcome = (event: 'finish' | 'close') => {
    if (settled) return;
    settled = true;
    const durationMs = Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - startedAt) / 1e6;
    const status = res.statusCode;
    const fields = {
      method: req.method,
      url: req.originalUrl,
      status,
      durationMs: Math.round(durationMs*100)/100,
      userId: req.user?.userId,
      contentLength: res.getHeader('content-length'),
      aborted: event === 'close' && !res.writableFinished,
    };
    const message = `HTTP ${req.method} ${req.originalUrl} -> ${status} in ${fields.durationMs}ms`;
    if (status >= 500) log.error(fields, message);
    else if (status >= 400) log.warn(fields, message);
    else log.info(fields, message);
  };

  res.on('finish', () => logOutcome('finish'));
  res.on('close', () => logOutcome('close'));

  // Hand the id to everything downstream of this middleware.
  runWithRequestContext({ requestId }, () => next());
};
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { childLogger } from '../utils/logger';
import { runWithRequestContext } from '../utils/requestContext';

/**
 * requestLogger
 * -------------
 * Assigns an end-to-end correlation id to every HTTP request and logs the
 * request/response pair as structured lines.
 *
 * The id comes from the inbound `X-Request-ID` header when a trusted caller
 * (mobile client, gateway, or the retrying dispatcher app) supplies one, and is
 * otherwise a fresh UUID. It is:
 *   - attached to `req.requestId`,
 *   - echoed back on the `X-Request-ID` response header,
 *   - bound into AsyncLocalStorage so services and the outbox payload can pick
 *     it up without threading it through every function signature,
 *   - and stamped on every log line the request produces.
 *
 * That is what makes a single id follow a booking from `POST /api/bookings`
 * through the MySQL outbox row to the background worker's webhook delivery.
 */

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      /** Correlation id for this request. Always set by `requestLogger`. */
      requestId: string;
    }
  }
}

export const REQUEST_ID_HEADER = 'X-Request-ID';

const MAX_REQUEST_ID_LENGTH = 128;

/**
 * Only opaque, log-safe tokens are accepted. Allowing arbitrary client input
 * through would let a caller forge log lines with embedded newlines or inject
 * extra headers via the echoed response header, so anything outside this
 * character set is discarded in favour of a server-generated UUID.
 */
const ACCEPTED_REQUEST_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9._:+-]+$/;

/** The inbound correlation id if it is trustworthy, otherwise a new UUID. */
export function resolveRequestId(req: Request): string {
  const header = req.headers[REQUEST_ID_HEADER.toLowerCase()];
  const candidate = Array.isArray(header) ? header[0] : header;

  if (
    typeof candidate === 'string' &&
    candidate.length > 0 &&
    candidate.length <= MAX_REQUEST_ID_LENGTH &&
    ACCEPTED_REQUEST_ID.test(candidate)
  ) {
    return candidate;
  }

  return uuidv4();
}

export const requestLogger = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  const requestId = resolveRequestId(req);
  req.requestId = requestId;

  // Echo the id so a client or upstream gateway can quote it when reporting a
  // failure, and so traces can be joined across service boundaries.
  res.setHeader(REQUEST_ID_HEADER, requestId);

  const log = childLogger({ requestId });
  const startedAt = process.hrtime.bigint();

  log.info(
    {
      method: req.method,
      url: req.originalUrl,
      ip: req.ip,
      userAgent: req.get('user-agent'),
    },
    'HTTP request received'
  );

  // `finish` covers a completed response; `close` also fires when the client
  // hangs up early, so an aborted request still leaves a trace. The guard keeps
  // whichever arrives first from logging twice.
  let settled = false;

  const logOutcome = (event: 'finish' | 'close'): void => {
    if (settled) return;
    settled = true;

    const durationMs = Math.round(Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - startedAt) / 1e4) / 100;
    const status = res.statusCode;

    const fields = {
      method: req.method,
      url: req.originalUrl,
      status,
      durationMs,
      userId: req.user?.userId,
      organizationId: req.user?.organizationId,
      aborted: event === 'close' && !res.writableFinished,
    };

    const message = `HTTP ${req.method} ${req.originalUrl} -> ${status} in ${durationMs}ms`;

    if (status >= 500) {
      log.error(fields, message);
    } else if (status >= 400) {
      log.warn(fields, message);
    } else {
      log.info(fields, message);
    }
  };

  res.on('finish', () => logOutcome('finish'));
  res.on('close', () => logOutcome('close'));

  // Express invokes downstream middleware synchronously from `next()`, so the
  // whole request - controller, service, Prisma transaction - runs inside this
  // binding and `getRequestId()` resolves for any of them.
  runWithRequestContext({ requestId }, () => next());
};

export default requestLogger;

```

```typescript
import { outboxService, ClaimedOutboxEvent, OUTBOX_STATUS } from '../services/outbox.service';
import { notificationService } from '../services/notification.service';
import { childLogger } from '../utils/logger';
import type { Logger } from 'pino';

/**
 * OutboxWorker
 * ------------
 * Background polling loop that drains the transactional outbox and delivers
 * each event to the Carrier Notify API.
 *
 * Guarantees:
 *  - Non-blocking: runs entirely outside the request path, so booking API
 *    responses never wait on a webhook HTTP call.
 *  - At-least-once: an event is only marked COMPLETED after a 2xx response;
 *    any other outcome returns it to PENDING with exponential backoff.
 *  - Duplicate-safe: events are atomically claimed (PROCESSING) so two workers
 *    never dispatch the same row, and every request carries the persisted
 *    eventId as X-Event-Id / Idempotency-Key so a redelivery after a
 *    "delivered but not recorded" crash is de-duplicated by the receiver.
 *  - Bounded: after maxRetries the event is parked as FAILED for review rather
 *    than retried forever.
 *  - Traceable: every log line for an event carries its `requestId` (the id of
 *    the HTTP request that created the booking), `eventId` and `bookingId`, so
 *    a carrier complaint can be followed from the API call through the outbox
 *    row to the webhook attempt.
 */

export interface OutboxWorkerConfig {
  pollIntervalMs: number;
  batchSize: number;
  maxConcurrency: number;
  processingLeaseMs: number;
  maxBatchesPerTick: number;
  enabled: boolean;
}

function readPositiveInt(name: string, fallback: number, allowZero = false): number {
  const raw = process.env[name];
  if (raw === undefined || raw === '') return fallback;
  const parsed = parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return fallback;
  if (parsed < 0 || (parsed === 0 && !allowZero)) return fallback;
  return parsed;
}

export class OutboxWorker {
  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  private currentTick: Promise<void> | null = null;
  private running = false;
  private started = false;

  /** Worker-lifecycle logger (no single event to correlate against). */
  private readonly log: Logger = childLogger({ component: 'OutboxWorker' });

  public readonly config: OutboxWorkerConfig = {
    pollIntervalMs: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS', 5000),
    batchSize: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE', 25),
    maxConcurrency: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_MAX_CONCURRENCY', 5),
    processingLeaseMs: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_PROCESSING_LEASE_MS', 60_000),
    maxBatchesPerTick: readPositiveInt('OUTBOX_MAX_BATCHES_PER_TICK', 4),
    enabled: process.env.OUTBOX_WORKER_ENABLED !== 'false',
  };

  /** True while a polling cycle is in flight. */
  public get isBusy(): boolean {
    return this.running;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Trace context
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * Logger scoped to one claimed event.
   *
   * `requestId` comes from the payload persisted at enqueue time, which is what
   * links this background delivery back to the originating HTTP request.
   * `bookingId` is the outbox aggregate id - every event this worker handles is
   * aggregated on a booking. A payload written before tracing existed (or by a
   * direct `[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]Payload` caller such as a test) simply omits `requestId`.
   */
  private eventLogger(event: ClaimedOutboxEvent): Logger {
    return this.log.child({
      eventId: event.eventId,
      bookingId: event.aggregateId,
      requestId: event.payload?.requestId,
      eventType: event.payload?.eventType,
    });
  }

  /** Normalises a caught value so pino's `err` serializer always applies. */
  private asError(error: unknown): Error {
    return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Lifecycle
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * Starts the polling loop and kicks off an immediate cycle so events created
   * during boot are not delayed by a full interval.
   */
  public start(): void {
    if (this.started) {
      this.log.warn('start() ignored - worker is already running.');
      return;
    }

    if (!this.config.enabled) {
      this.log.info(
        'Disabled via OUTBOX_WORKER_ENABLED=false. No events will be dispatched.'
      );
      return;
    }

    this.started = true;

    this.log.info(
      {
        pollIntervalMs: this.config.pollIntervalMs,
        batchSize: this.config.batchSize,
        maxConcurrency: this.config.maxConcurrency,
        processingLeaseMs: this.config.processingLeaseMs,
        target: process.env.CARRIER_NOTIFY_URL || 'http://localhost:4001/notify',
      },
      'Outbox worker started.'
    );

    this.timer = setInterval(() => {
      void this.tick();
    }, this.config.pollIntervalMs);

    // Do not hold the event loop open on the worker's account - the HTTP server
    // owns process lifetime, and this keeps test runners from hanging.
    this.timer.unref?.();

    void this.tick();
  }

  /**
   * Stops scheduling new cycles and waits for the in-flight one to finish, so
   * every claimed event reaches a terminal state before the process exits.
   */
  public async stop(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.started) return;

    this.started = false;

    if (this.timer) {
      clearInterval(this.timer);
      this.timer = null;
    }

    if (this.currentTick) {
      this.log.info('Waiting for in-flight delivery cycle to finish...');
      await this.currentTick;
    }

    this.log.info('Outbox worker stopped.');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Poll cycle
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** Single poll cycle. Guarded against re-entrancy so cycles never overlap. */
  public async tick(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.running) {
      // Previous cycle is still working through a slow batch; skip this beat.
      return;
    }

    this.running = true;
    this.currentTick = this.runCycle();

    try {
      await this.currentTick;
    } finally {
      this.running = false;
      this.currentTick = null;
    }
  }

  private async runCycle(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const recovered = await outboxService.recoverStaleProcessing(
        this.config.processingLeaseMs
      );
      if (recovered > 0) {
        this.log.warn(
          { recovered, processingLeaseMs: this.config.processingLeaseMs },
          'Requeued event(s) abandoned in PROCESSING by a previous worker.'
        );
      }

      for (let batch = 0; batch < this.config.maxBatchesPerTick; batch++) {
        const claimed = await outboxService.claimPendingEvents(this.config.batchSize);
        if (claimed.length === 0) return;

        // The batch summary carries the identifying triple for every row, so a
        // claim is traceable even before the per-event lines are emitted.
        this.log.info(
          {
            claimedCount: claimed.length,
            eventIds: claimed.map((event) => event.eventId),
            bookingIds: claimed.map((event) => event.aggregateId),
            requestIds: claimed.map((event) => event.payload?.requestId),
          },
          `Claimed ${claimed.length} outbox event(s) for delivery.`
        );

        await this.dispatchBatch(claimed);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      // A polling cycle must never crash the process - the next tick retries.
      this.log.error({ err: this.asError(error) }, 'Outbox poll cycle failed.');
    }
  }

  /** Delivers a claimed batch with bounded parallelism. */
  private async dispatchBatch(events: ClaimedOutboxEvent[]): Promise<void> {
    await this.runWithConcurrency(events, this.config.maxConcurrency, (event) =>
      this.dispatchEvent(event)
    );
  }

  /**
   * Delivers one event and commits its outcome. A failure to *record* the
   * outcome is logged but deliberately not rethrown: the event stays
   * PROCESSING and the stale-claim sweep will requeue it.
   */
  private async dispatchEvent(event: ClaimedOutboxEvent): Promise<void> {
    const log = this.eventLogger(event);
    const attempt = event.retryCount + 1;

    log.info(
      { attempt, maxRetries: event.maxRetries },
      'Dispatching outbox event to the carrier webhook.'
    );

    const result = await notificationService.dispatchCarrierNotification(
      event.eventId,
      event.payload
    );

    try {
      if (result.ok) {
        await outboxService.markCompleted(event);
        log.info(
          { attempt, httpStatus: result.status, outboxRowId: event.id },
          'Outbox event delivered to the carrier webhook.'
        );
        return;
      }

      const detail = result.error
        ? result.error
        : `HTTP ${result.status} from carrier notify API: ${this.describeBody(result.body)}`;

      if (!notificationService.isRetryable(result)) {
        await outboxService.markFailed(event, `Non-retryable ${detail}`);
        log.error(
          { attempt, httpStatus: result.status, detail, outboxRowId: event.id },
          'Outbox event parked as FAILED (non-retryable). It will not be retried.'
        );
        return;
      }

      const outcome = await outboxService.recordFailure(event, detail);

      if (outcome.status === OUTBOX_STATUS.FAILED) {
        log.error(
          {
            attempt: outcome.retryCount,
            maxRetries: event.maxRetries,
            httpStatus: result.status,
            detail,
            outboxRowId: event.id,
          },
          `Outbox event failed permanently after ${event.maxRetries} retries.`
        );
      } else {
        log.warn(
          {
            attempt: outcome.retryCount,
            maxRetries: event.maxRetries,
            httpStatus: result.status,
            backoffMs: outcome.delayMs,
            nextRetryAt: outcome.nextRetryAt?.toISOString(),
            detail,
            outboxRowId: event.id,
          },
          `Outbox delivery failed; retrying in ${outcome.delayMs}ms with exponential backoff.`
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      log.error(
        { err: this.asError(error), outboxRowId: event.id },
        'Could not record the delivery outcome; the event stays PROCESSING until the lease sweep requeues it.'
      );
    }
  }

  private describeBody(body: any): string {
    if (body === null || body === undefined) return '(empty response body)';
    if (typeof body === 'string') return body.slice(0, 300);
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(body).slice(0, 300);
    } catch {
      return '(unserializable response body)';
    }
  }

  /** Simple worker-pool: at most `limit` promises in flight at any moment. */
  private async runWithConcurrency<T>(
    items: T[],
    limit: number,
    task: (item: T) => Promise<void>
  ): Promise<void> {
    const queue = [...items];
    const lanes = Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, queue.length) }, async () => {
      for (let item = queue.shift(); item !== undefined; item = queue.shift()) {
        await task(item);
      }
    });

    await Promise.all(lanes);
  }
}

export const outboxWorker = new OutboxWorker();
```

```typescript
async function resolveFixture() {
  const candidates = await prisma.warehouse.findMany({
    where: { policy: null },
    include: { docks: { where: { status: 'ACTIVE' }, orderBy: { id: 'asc' } }, operatingHours: true },
  });

  for (const warehouse of candidates) {
    const hours = warehouse.operatingHours;
    if (warehouse.docks.length === 0 || hours.length < 7) continue;
    const alwaysOpen = hours.every(
      (h: any) => h.openTime === '00:00' && (h.closeTime === '24:00' || h.closeTime === '00:00')
    );
    const uniform = hours.every((h: any) => h.slotLengthMinutes === hours[0].slotLengthMinutes);
    if (!alwaysOpen || !uniform) continue;

    const len = hours[0].slotLengthMinutes as number;
    const stepMs = len * 60 * 1000;
    // Any future instant, aligned to the slot grid, is valid for a 24/7 warehouse.
    const base = Math.ceil((Date.now() + 6 * 86400000) / stepMs) * stepMs;
    const start = new Date(base);
    const start2 = new Date(base + stepMs);

    return {
      name: warehouse.name as string,
      dockId: warehouse.docks[0].id as number,
      slotMinutes: len,
      start,
      end: new Date(base + stepMs),
      start2,
      end2: new Date(base + 2 * stepMs),
    };
  }
  throw new Error('No 24/7 policy-free warehouse with an ACTIVE dock found.');
}
```
